verses.text: Why do you stand so far away, LORD? Why do you hide when trouble comes?
In their arrogance the wicked hunt down the weak. Let them get caught in the schemes they devise.
The wicked boast about what they crave. They bless the greedy and speak against the LORD.
The wicked carry themselves with pride. There’s no room for God in their thoughts.
Everything they do seems to prosper. They’re arrogant and keep your laws out of sight. They sneer at all their enemies.
They tell themselves, “Nothing will shake me. Trouble won’t touch me for generations.”
Their mouths are full of curses, lies, and threats. Trouble and evil are under their tongues.
They lie in wait near villages and murder innocent people from hiding. They keep a secret watch on those who can’t defend themselves.
They hide like a lion waiting to pounce. They lie in wait for the helpless and catch them by pulling them into their nets.
The helpless are crushed. They collapse and fall under the weight of their attackers.
The wicked tell themselves, “God has forgotten. He’s turned away. He’ll never see it.”
Rise up, LORD! Lift up your hand, God! Remember those who can’t defend themselves.
Why do the wicked speak against God and tell themselves, “He’ll never hold me to account”?
But you do see their trouble and grief, and you take it into your own hands. You help the victim and the fatherless.
Break the power of the wicked. Call evildoers to account until no wickedness is left to uncover.
The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will vanish from his land.
LORD, you hear what the humble long for. You steady their hearts and listen to them,
to give justice to the fatherless and the oppressed, so mere mortals can terrorize them no more.
